In addition to a major update to Final Cut Camera, Apple also announced updates for Pages, Keynote, Numbers, Pixelmator Pro, and Freeform. Below are the new features in this round of updates.

Apple rolls out updates to its 'Creator Studio' apps, with new features available to non-subscribers as well

Apple today announced new features for its popular iWork suite—Pages, Keynote, and Numbers—along with several improvements to Pixelmator Pro and Freeform.

Some of the new features are exclusive to Apple Creator Studio subscribers, but selected features are available to all users. Below is a roundup of all the new features compiled from the Apple Newsroom:

Pages, Keynote, Numbers

Apple says the update lets users ask Siri questions about Pages, Keynote, or Numbers and get answers. It's not yet clear whether Apple Intelligence is required, but it's likely. The update also adds the ability to 'request access to shared presentations, documents, or spreadsheets,' making collaboration easier since file owners no longer need to actively open sharing.

Pages for Mac gains a new Screen View that 'optimizes content display for reading and focused writing.' Numbers adds 'trigonometric, statistical, and logical functions' to help solve complex problems in spreadsheets.

In addition, Apple Creator Studio subscribers can use new templates and themes across the three iWork apps. Keynote also gains an intelligent slide generation feature that can automatically produce images tailored to specific presentation content.

Pixelmator Pro

Pixelmator Pro for iPad adds selection and masking tools that were previously available only on the Mac version. Both the Mac and iPad versions gain two new template collections designed for sports and action-themed projects, plus new templates designed for 'launching new creative concepts, businesses, or products.'

From a popular comment by Richard Lewis (Rich)

Wondering whether the standalone version of Pixelmator Pro is getting updates? The answer is no (nothing has been announced so far). The current 3.8 version hasn't been updated for nearly five months.

In addition, a new Podcast category has been added, making it easier to create cover artwork that fits the dimensions of major podcast platforms.

Freeform

Which of the new features in this update appeal to you the most? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
